text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
All concerns have been addressed.
I will not repeat the mistakes of my last race.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
The adjustments we worked on together for this race...
Now is the time to prove we were right...

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
What I couldn't bring home from my last race...
I'll bring it home this time. Without fail.
